nodes.description: Constant uint256 public TOTAL_SUPPLY = 9999, the hard cap on total NFTs mintable.
uint256 public PRICE = 0.1 ether, mint price per token, mutable by the owner via setPricePerNFT.
uint256 public maxMintPerTransaction = 5, caps tokens minted per transaction, owner mutable.
string public placeholderURI used as token metadata when a drop starting index is unset.
mapping(uint256 => Drops) public drops, holds fromIndex/toIndex/totalAmount/startingIndex/startingIndexBlock/dropIsActive for the three sale drops.
address payable treasury, recipient of claimETH proceeds and the onlyTreasury authorized caller.
bool publicSaleIsActive gate for mintFunkyMonkeyFratHouse, toggled by flipSale.
Public payable mint function; enforces sale active, supply, per-tx count and payment, then loops _safeMint to msg.sender.
Collects the contract balance to treasury, guarded by onlyTreasury(treasury).
Override that computes the drop-relative modded token id and returns the placeholder or super.tokenURI value.
Owner-only initialization of drops[0] (Toga Party) with fromIndex/toIndex/totalAmount and optional starting index activation.
Owner-only toggle of publicSaleIsActive.
Owner-only setter for PRICE.
Owner-only setter for the treasury payable address.
Internal ERC721 safe mint; mints then calls _checkOnERC721Received on the recipient contract.
Private ERC721 helper that externally calls onERC721Received on the receiving contract.
Caller-supplied sender address used for ownership/treasury authorization and as mint recipient.
payable(address(treasury)).transfer(address(this).balance) sends the full contract balance to an externally controlled address.
Low-level functionCall into the receiver's onERC721Received, transferring control to an untrusted contract mid-transfer.
Owner-only setter forwarding to ERC721 _setBaseURI.
Owner-only setter for maxMintPerTransaction.
Owner-only setter for placeholderURI.
Owner-only initialization of drops[1] (Greek Life).
Owner-only initialization of drops[2] (Pirate Parade).
Internal ERC721 ownership transfer that clears approvals and updates holder/token-owner enumerables.
Internal ERC721 mint that registers the token in _holderTokens and _tokenOwners and emits Transfer.
address private _owner from Ownable, set to the deployer and reference for onlyOwner checks.
User-supplied token quantity parameter of mintFunkyMonkeyFratHouse.
Local computed supply after the requested mint, compared against drop totalAmount.
Loop-local token id derived from totalSupply() and passed to _safeMint.
New price argument of setPricePerNFT.
New per-transaction mint cap argument of setMaxMintsPerTransaction.
New placeholder metadata URI argument of setPlaceholderURI.
New treasury payable address argument of setTreasuryWallet.
New base URI argument of setBaseURI.
Token id argument of tokenURI used for range and modulo computations.
Memory copy of the matching Drops struct inside tokenURI.
Reveal-shifted token id computed as drop.fromIndex + ((tokenId + drop.startingIndex) % (drop.fromIndex + drop.totalAmount)).
Boolean argument of flipSale that sets publicSaleIsActive.
Start index argument of the initDropConfig* functions.
End index argument of the initDropConfig* functions, required to be greater than _fromIndex.
Total amount argument of the initDropConfig* functions, also used as modulo for the starting index.

edges.reason: flipSale is guarded by onlyOwner, which compares owner() against the untrusted msg.sender.
setPricePerNFT is guarded by onlyOwner, authorizing the untrusted caller against _owner.
setTreasuryWallet is guarded by onlyOwner, authorizing the untrusted caller against _owner.
setBaseURI is guarded by onlyOwner, authorizing the untrusted caller against _owner.
setMaxMintsPerTransaction is guarded by onlyOwner, authorizing the untrusted caller against _owner.
setPlaceholderURI is guarded by onlyOwner, authorizing the untrusted caller against _owner.
initDropConfigTogaParty is guarded by onlyOwner, authorizing the untrusted caller against _owner.
initDropConfigGreekLife is guarded by onlyOwner, authorizing the untrusted caller against _owner.
initDropConfigPirateParade is guarded by onlyOwner, authorizing the untrusted caller against _owner.
claimETH is guarded by onlyTreasury(treasury), comparing the untrusted msg.sender to the treasury address.
mintFunkyMonkeyFratHouse uses msg.sender as the recipient of every minted token.
Mint requires publicSaleIsActive to be true before proceeding.
Mint enforces totalSupply().add(numberOfTokens) <= TOTAL_SUPPLY.
Mint enforces numberOfTokens <= maxMintPerTransaction.
Mint computes PRICE.mul(numberOfTokens) with SafeMath to compare against msg.value.
Mint reads and writes drops[] to enforce per-drop totalAmount and startingIndexBlock.
Mint calls _safeMint, which can transfer control to an untrusted receiver before the loop finishes.
_safeMint internally calls _mint to register the new token before the receiver check.
_safeMint invokes _checkOnERC721Received which externally calls the recipient contract.
_checkOnERC721Received performs an untrusted external call into onERC721Received.
claimETH reads the treasury state variable as the destination of the balance transfer.
claimETH sends the whole contract balance to the treasury via transfer, an external value transfer.
tokenURI reads drops[] ranges to select the applicable drop config.
tokenURI returns placeholderURI when the drop starting index is not yet set.
initDropConfigTogaParty writes the drops[0] configuration and deactivates other drops.
initDropConfigGreekLife writes the drops[1] configuration and deactivates other drops.
initDropConfigPirateParade writes the drops[2] configuration and deactivates other drops.
flipSale writes the publicSaleIsActive sale gate.
setPricePerNFT overwrites the PRICE state variable.
setTreasuryWallet overwrites the treasury state variable.
setPlaceholderURI overwrites the placeholderURI state variable.
setMaxMintsPerTransaction overwrites the maxMintPerTransaction state variable.
User-supplied numberOfTokens flows into mint supply, per-tx and payment checks and the mint loop.
totalTokensAfterMint is computed locally inside mint and compared to drop totalAmount.
mintIndex is the loop-local token id derived from totalSupply() inside mint.
_price parameter is assigned into the PRICE state variable.
_maxMintPerTransaction parameter is assigned into the maxMintPerTransaction state variable.
_placeholderURI parameter is assigned into the placeholderURI state variable.
_treasury parameter is assigned into the treasury state variable.
baseURI_ parameter is forwarded to _setBaseURI by setBaseURI.
tokenId parameter drives the drop range checks and the modded id computation.
drop is the local copy of the selected Drops struct used in tokenURI.
moddedId is computed with addition and modulo arithmetic over drop indices inside tokenURI.
_isActive parameter is assigned into the publicSaleIsActive state variable.
_fromIndex parameter flows into the drops[0].fromIndex configuration.
_toIndex parameter flows into the drops[0].toIndex configuration and the range require.
_totalAmount parameter flows into drops[0].totalAmount and the starting index modulo.

normalization_plan.reason: The parameter only exists to size the mint loop and payment/supply checks of mintFunkyMonkeyFratHouse, so it should be folded into that core function node.
Local supply projection computed and consumed entirely within mintFunkyMonkeyFratHouse against drop totalAmount.
Loop-local token id generated and immediately passed to _safeMint inside mintFunkyMonkeyFratHouse.
Setter parameter whose only effect is writing the PRICE state variable inside setPricePerNFT.
Setter parameter whose only effect is writing maxMintPerTransaction inside setMaxMintsPerTransaction.
Setter parameter whose only effect is writing placeholderURI inside setPlaceholderURI.
Setter parameter whose only effect is writing the treasury state variable inside setTreasuryWallet.
Parameter forwarded directly to _setBaseURI and otherwise unused, so it belongs to setBaseURI.
Parameter used only for drop range comparisons and the modded id computation inside tokenURI.
Memory copy of the selected Drops struct that exists only inside the tokenURI reveal calculation.
Arithmetic-derived token id local to tokenURI and consumed by the super.tokenURI call.
Single boolean parameter of flipSale whose only effect is writing publicSaleIsActive.
Drop configuration parameter written into drops[0].fromIndex, representative of the initDropConfig* family.
Drop configuration parameter written into drops[0].toIndex and bounded by the range require.
Drop configuration parameter written into drops[0].totalAmount and used as the starting index modulus.
